desc: Derive model: each color follows its own permutation; a ball at s≠X forces operations on its path until reaching X; impossible iff s not in X's cycle for that color.
Prove minimality: forced boxes each operated exactly once; valid order = decreasing distance to X along path; answer = |union of forced boxes|.
Simplify via permutation structure: forced set per color = suffix of X's cycle from earliest source position (no trees exist in permutation functional graphs).
Implement final Python solution with O(N) time/memory, fast I/O, and verify samples 1–4 (4, 0, -1, 8 all confirmed).
